== Biography ==
<!-- BEE AutoBio start-->

Marion Columbus Glasgow was born on 25 Aug 1843 in Weakey, Tennessee, USA, son of [[Glasgow-108|Elijah Glasgow]] (1815 - 1875) and [[Jeans-78|Jane Caroline (Jeans) Glasgow]] (1820 - 1854).

His siblings were:
#[[Glasgow-361|William Thomas Glasgow]] (1838 - 1914)
#[[Glasgow-310|Martha Anne Glasgow]] (1842 - )
#[[Glascow-13|Martha Glascow]] (~1842 - )
#[[Glasgow-130|Dorris Kennedy Glasgow]] (1842 - 1912)
#[[Glascow-11|Maria Glascow]] (~1844 - )
#[[Glasgow-351|Washington Barry Jeans Glasgow]] (1845 - 1907)
#[[Glascow-10|Washington Barry Jeans Glascow]] (~1846 - )
#[[Glasgow-272|James Monroe Glasgow]] (1847 - 1907)
#[[Glascow-12|James M Glascow]] (~1847 - 1907)
#[[Glasgow-125|Mary Jane Buenavesta Glasgow]] (1848 - 1907)
#[[Glasgow-131|Margaret Elizabeth Glasgow]] (1852 - 1911)
#[[Glasgow-128|Irvin Glasgow]] (~1853 - )
#[[Glasgow-127|Nancy C Glasgow]] (1868 - )
#[[Glasgow-126|Martha P Glasgow]] (1870 - )

Marion married [[Nettles-230|Sarah Frances Nettles]] (1838 - 1884). Their daughter was [[Glasgow-232|Dora Jane (Glasgow) Deniston]] (1868 - 1914).

Marion died on 8 Sep 1916 in Rector, Clay, Arkansas, United States aged 73.

=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===
